digest.component_or_area: code-review gate; write-op surface parity overlay
propositions: A new surface-parity overlay is added to the code-review gate as a glob-triggered, advisory finder (blocking_enabled=false) that detects when a write-op param/guard/required-field changes on one adapter without matching updates to sibling adapters (lib, CLI, MCP).

The overlay routes via glob patterns on the three write-surface files (_commands/*, _lib_writes.py, _mcp_writes.py) and is wired into round_a/round_b batches of the code-review gate so the finder is actually dispatched, not merely registered.

The overlay is non-blocking (block_threshold=0.95, advisory posture) and carries false-positive guards for justified divergences: deliberate policy exceptions, adapter-bound params (_creation_channel, return_alias, source, repo_root), and internal-only refactors with no caller-visible change.

The reviewer prompt enumerates the three write surfaces and instructs the LLM to grep sibling adapters for the changed param and verify lockstep updates; the base-reviewer catalog is updated to list surface-parity and index.json remains unchanged (overlays excluded from selection).
The overlay is portability-proven: it runs in-process via rebar.review_code/produce_code_review_verdict with no CI provider dependency, satisfying project.portability.

Unit tests assert overlay membership, routing shape, glob firing on each write adapter, and round_a/round_b dispatch; drift tests confirm base-reviewer catalog parity and index.json byte-identity after regen.
